info.description: 2026-11-05, Asia/Tashkent. Confirmed ordinary/statistical bonus product rules from UA-SRC-GRADING-USER-20261105. Full OpenAPI review candidate based on branding.1 of 0.2.2-review-no-grading.2. New wire names, endpoints, numeric/participant/unanswered policies await review or decisions. post.description: Verify raw initData HMAC/freshness/configured bot, consumed409 INIT_DATA_REPLAY, invalid401 INIT_DATA_INVALID, stale401 INIT_DATA_EXPIRED. Fresh login proposed single active family revokes predecessors. Lost response uses existing local session first then fresh launch; reload not guaranteed new initData. No attempt reset.

Opaque body proof distinct from staff SDK. Fixed absolute lifetime, atomic consume+rotation+old access revoke, reuse revokes entire family. Single-flight; lost refresh response no blind retry, fresh Telegram launch. AUTH expiry never restarts or pauses exam.

Authenticate using valid StudentSession bearer OR nonempty Logout.refresh_token proof in optional body. security {} represents body-token proof, never anonymous success. No bearer and no body/proof ->401 LOGOUT_PROOF_REQUIRED; malformed JSON400; supplied empty proof422. Unknown/expired unverifiable proof401 REFRESH_INVALID or REFRESH_EXPIRED. Known previously revoked same family proof200 Ack within approved tombstone retention; retain hashed proof only. If both supplied, both must identify same family else401 LOGOUT_PROOF_MISMATCH; invalid bearer cannot be ignored to downgrade to body proof. Atomic family revocation invalidates all access/refresh immediately; no exam change.

post.description: Atomic PostgreSQL clock_timestamp() captured after locks (transaction-start now() insufficient); opens<=now<closes gates NEW normal start only. Deadline=start+full duration, never min(close). Enforce unique pupil+stable demo normal attempt across version/group/assignment, active group+roster/profile. Technical current-ready window gates start but full duration persists beyond close. Same active attempt retry resumes; no copied answers. U-GR-15: actual admission must preserve already-rostered late pupils' local EOD start right independently of classroom session end. Full started duration may extend past this cutoff. GB-05 configuration unresolved.

put.description: O-01. Teacher with current own-group grant and manage_roster may initially add a never-placed registered pupil, remove own active member, or re-add an inactive pupil whose server-owned placement affinity is this group. A transfer changes affinity even if the pupil is later removed; owning both groups never permits cross-group re-add. Different-affinity active writes by any actor must use privileged transfer. Removal revokes old unstarted grants by membership epoch, cancels unsent notices and recalculates barriers; history and normal-demo usage remain. Re-add never resurrects old grants. Removal/transfer blocked409 ACTIVE_EXAM_OR_RECOVERY for active attempts or ANY approved ready recovery with closes_at > locked now, including future opens. Auth/scope/privacy before state and replay; group+membership CAS, transaction and K as x-membership-rules. Returns immutable command receipt. The product authority is confirmed in Master Context 1.0; exact capability/scope, affinity and concurrency mechanics here are review design and do not constitute new historical approvals.

Attempt.description: Only current active own permitted attempt contains question/answer arrays. Ready/terminal arrays empty; each active image URL refresh does not alter mapping/time. Deadline is start+FULL duration, never min(admission close). Technical successor starts blank, new mapping; old cancelled retained.

History.description: Own history remains accessible after membership removal/transfer/assignment cancellation, without granting new starts. Required lifecycle_status and cancellation independent of nullable closed score. No staff-only details anywhere in student results; runtime authorization and filtering NOT_TESTED.

DetailedReview.description: Own current completed attempt only, with currently open complete review gate. Correct key/explanation access and authenticated solution-image route unchanged. No additional per-question grading payload proposed on this gated review route; stored ordinary/bonus aggregate result separate.

StudentSummary.description: Scoped student read supplies current membership_revision for transfer precondition. Admin/Owner all-group student scope; Teacher own-group/approved-subject students only. A revision is not mutation authorization. Includes permanent Qadam ID; standard directory remains scoped. Narrow initial-placement and same-affinity lookup use separate candidate routes.

Version.description: Draft or published test duration/instructions and explicit ordinary grading configuration. Shared revision/published immutability remain. Proposed wire addition; individual points and numeric validity require GB-02.

ResultRow.description: Existing scoped student and series context with proposed closed ordinary plus optional frozen bonus aggregates. Original group attribution and lifecycle remain independent; no unreleased answer/explanation fields.

UploadTicket.description: Capability for one quarantine object only. PUT exact original bytes, no multipart/base64; required_headers verbatim; never attach Qadam bearer/refresh to upload_url. Expiry clock enforced by storage; URL is secret. Retry only identical bytes while ticket valid, before complete; success statuses supplied by ticket. Completion seals snapshot; validation promotes separate immutable copy.

Logout.description: Refresh-proof branch only. Required nonempty refresh token when body supplied. Bearer-only logout omits body entirely.

TeacherOnboarding.description: Initial provider-verified applicant self-registration and selected subjects, approved by Admin (Owner all-rights allowed). Existing approved Teacher cannot reuse onboarding to request later subject changes.

MemberWrite.description: O-01: group revision AND membership revision CAS. Teacher initial placement, own-group removal, or same-affinity re-add only; different-affinity placement requires privileged transfer. Active/recovery guard for removal/transfer. UUID selected through authorized directory/candidate; Qadam ID itself grants nothing.

TeacherAssignment.description: Direct replacement; expected_revision is current Group.revision. Same set semantics as approved TeacherAssignPayload.

VersionCreate.description: Draft or published test duration/instructions and explicit ordinary grading configuration. Shared revision/published immutability remain. Proposed wire addition; individual points and numeric validity require GB-02.

anyOf.description: Numeric wire proposal; exact range, scale and rounding remain GB-02. Schema validity is not approval of numeric policy.

individual_points.description: Per-question value for individual_enabled=true. Drafts may be incomplete; publish needs every effective base point and an approved GB-02 policy. false always means effective base point 1, not this input. null is not an approved published individual score.

QuestionWrite.description: Full draft content upsert with optional individual_points. Existing four-option, path-ID, shared version revision, approved-subject/asset and published freeze rules remain. Required per-question values are checked at publish, conditional on GradingConfig.

AssignmentCreate.description: Group roster/pinned version and explicit UTC admission schedule/IANA timezone, subject/group authorization. Classroom session end must not revoke already-rostered late pupils' start right until EOD (U-GR-15). Actual day/timezone/cutoff GB-05 unresolved; do not select early admission close as a classroom finish. Existing reminders and review policy preserved.

reminder_lead_seconds.description: Optional: absent preserves per-assignment lead; null disables pre-opening reminder. Authorized group/subject Teacher may configure within approved server bounds. Never changes active attempt deadlines.

AssignmentPatch.description: Existing admission edit shape; server must reject using classroom finish/cancel/revoke to erase U-GR-15 protected late-start rights. Started full deadlines never shorten. EOD timezone/day configuration and policy exceptions unresolved GB-05; wire field for classroom-session completion not invented.

ReviewWindow.description: O-02. Owner or Admin with current manage_review_window capability and assignment group/subject mutation scope. Teacher cannot execute. Normal admission must have ended and full barrier must be complete; never override active or approved-ready recovery. extend only currently open gate with until > current close and now; reopen only previously opened, now closed gate with until > now. No first-release or teacher-approval bypass. Frozen IANA timezone, reason, gate CAS and reauthorized K; old/new cutoff, actor/delegation and reason audited atomically.

TeacherAssignPayload.description: Approval command; group_id == scope_group_id, teacher_id == target_id. Envelope target_revision is current Group.revision. Empty removes final assignment, duplicates rejected.

SubjectRightsPayload.description: Complete replacement of EXISTING teacher approved-subject set. Admin formal request, Owner approval. Empty array removes final right; no implicit merge. Diff added/removed audit derived server-side. Removing subjects deactivates corresponding group-subject grants atomically; adding later never auto-restores old group grants. Teacher role/profile remains but subject-content/data capabilities become empty when no approved subjects.

Request_subject_rights_change.description: Formal later existing-teacher subject-right request. Requester must be current Admin; Teacher direct submission forbidden even for own subjects. Owner decides. Separate from initial applicant self-registration/subject selection, initially approved by Admin.

StudentCandidate.description: Minimal roster candidate. No Telegram identity/contact, credentials, other group, results, roles or membership history. Eligibility checked before disclosure; not a grant.

MembershipMutation.description: Immutable command receipt at application time, not a current membership snapshot. Same K replay never reapplies effects; fetch current scoped state separately.

individual_enabled.description: Explicit Teacher choice; false means every question has base_points=1; true uses a separate input for every question. No initial toggle default chosen.

GradingConfig.description: PROPOSED wire names for confirmed U-GR-01/02. Published configuration and effective base points form the grading snapshot. Not a second mutually exclusive statistical-bonus mode.

earned_points.description: Numeric wire proposal; exact range, scale and rounding remain GB-02. Schema validity is not approval of numeric policy.

max_points.description: Numeric wire proposal; exact range, scale and rounding remain GB-02. Schema validity is not approval of numeric policy.

percentage.description: Numeric wire proposal; exact range, scale and rounding remain GB-02. Schema validity is not approval of numeric policy.

OrdinaryScore.description: Confirmed ordinary aggregates: correct adds effective base points, wrong adds 0; percentage=earned_points/max_points*100. Calculated and stored at completion. earned_points.description: Numeric wire proposal; exact range, scale and rounding remain GB-02. Schema validity is not approval of numeric policy.

StudentStatisticalBonusScore.description: Optional additional aggregate from an immutable original-group test calculation; wrong contributes 0, correct contributes base_points*(1+incorrect_share). AttemptGradingResult.description: Proposed closed result boundary shared by own aggregate result/history and scoped staff summaries. Completed submitted/expired/forced attempts require ordinary; ready/in_progress/recovery_lapsed have no completed score. A cancelled predecessor may retain a previously stored ordinary score as historical, never official. Cancellation/lifecycle are external, never inferred from score. Bonus only for attempts in the saved population; nonmembers cannot inherit another group calculation. Relation checks are server invariants, not JSON Schema proof.

CompletedGradingResult.description: Submit/force completion returns the stored ordinary result synchronously, statistical_bonus nullable. No waiting for group admission close or bonus. Full deadline/idempotent terminal rules remain.

StatisticalBonusWarning.description: Confirmed warning obligation, technical code proposed. No minimum participants imposed; warning threshold and UI placement GB-04 unresolved.

base_points.description: Numeric wire proposal; exact range, scale and rounding remain GB-02. Schema validity is not approval of numeric policy.

final_question_points.description: Numeric wire proposal; exact range, scale and rounding remain GB-02. Schema validity is not approval of numeric policy.

StatisticalBonusQuestionSnapshot.description: Staff-only persisted per-question snapshot. incorrect_share=incorrect_count/counted_participant_count; final_question_points=base_points*(1+incorrect_share). GB-01 selects how unanswered affects numerator/denominator, GB-02 numeric policy, GB-03 eligible attempts. They must be resolved before actual computation; schema cannot prove arithmetic or cohort membership.

unanswered_policy_id.description: No approved value yet (GB-01); do not choose a value from this draft.

StatisticalBonusCalculation.description: PROPOSED staff-only representation of one immutable original-group+test population and grading snapshot. Absent roster members and other groups excluded. Retry under same OR different K returns this calculation, never creates another. Per-attempt final totals stored separately and exposed through AttemptGradingResult only in original saved population. No accepted policy IDs exist yet; not executable until open decisions resolve. Cohort identity across future repeated assignments GB-08.

StatisticalBonusStatus.description: PROPOSED Panel status. Classroom session end is never admission_closed. Before first calculation require actual protected EOD start window ended and all started attempts complete; existing approved-ready recovery is not silently bypassed. Unresolved policies block actual activation in this draft and are returned explicitly, not guessed. Small-group warning is nonblocking once GB-04 is agreed. calculation non-null means existing frozen result; no recalculate/overwrite operation.

ErrorResponse.description: Structured safe error. See canonical document/code catalog; no credentials/keys/foreign PII.

GB-02: Ball va foiz aniqligi. Ballning ruxsat etilgan ishorasi/0/min/max/kasr xonalari; oddiy va bonus hisoblarining saqlash aniqligi, yaxlitlash bosqichi/usuli; maksimal oddiy ball 0 bo‘lsa amal. 2,5 ball mumkinligi misolda tasdiqlangan, 2 kasrli umumiy qoida emas.

GB-03: Hisobga olinadigan urinishlar. submitted/expired/forced, recovery va cancelled predecessorning statistikadagi aniq tanlovi; bir o‘quvchi uchun qaysi urinish olinishi va dublikatlardan himoya. Kelmaganlar kiritilmasligi tasdiqlangan. 0 topshiruvchi bo‘lsa ulush aniqlanmagan; bu minimal guruh cheklovi tanlanganini anglatmaydi.
GB-04: Kichik guruh ogohlantirishi. Ogohlantirish son chegarasi, matni va qaysi ekranda berilishi; bu ogohlantirish faollashtirishni taqiqlovchi minimum emas.

GB-06: Bonusga oid qo‘shimcha vakolatlar. O‘qituvchining o‘z guruhi uchun tanlovi va Eganing umumiy huquqi saqlanadi. Adminning bonusni faollashtirish vakolati/scope berilishi hali belgilanmagan; Admin read huquqidan mutation kelib chiqmaydi.

GB-07: Bonusdan keyingi recovery va tuzatishlar. Keyingi recovery/mazmunli tuzatish/qayta kirish bo‘lsa bonusni saqlash va ko‘rsatish jarayoni; saqlangan hisobni yangilashga ruxsat yo‘q, alohida protsedura kelishilishi kerak.

GB-08: Kontrakt shakli va qo‘llanish doirasi. Yangi maydon/endpoint nomlari, backward compatibility va agent review; kelajakdagi dars/diagnostika uchun eski 1/2/3 va 1/1,5/2 qoidalarini yangi toggle bilan birlashtirish; bir guruh+demo qayta assignment bo‘lsa cohort identifikatori; UI toggle boshlang‘ich holati va bonusni birinchi demo pilotiga kiritish navbati.
